ENGAGEMENT REQUEST (fictional)

From: Petra Voss, General Counsel, Harrowgate Systems Inc.

Harrowgate Systems Inc. asks the firm to advise on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Northwind Logistics Ltd, including a review of the supplier's redline and the negotiation of the liability cap.

Our postal address is 14 Quay Street, Gothenburg 411 04, Sweden.

The agreed fee is a fixed fee of USD 18,000 for the renewal negotiation, payable in two instalments.

Please direct all correspondence to Petra Voss.

TERM SHEET — PROJECT LANTERN (fictional)

Parties: Alder Biotech AB and Northbridge Analytics Ltd.

The parties intend to exchange confidential information to evaluate a joint venture in clinical data analytics.

Confidential information shall be protected for three (3) years from the date of the agreement.

The agreement will be governed by the laws of Sweden.
